summary.caption: High-taste, fully colored 2D anime digital painting comic page, crisp clean line art with soft cel shading and gentle painterly highlights, bright warm kitchen daylight, fresh pastel palette of lemon yellow, soft pink and cool grey, expressive comedic facial expressions, zero rough sketch lines.; A younger sister eats the older sister's pudding, panics and runs away.; 2girls, sisters, home kitchen, open refrigerator, pudding cup, slapstick comedy; Japanese manga layout read right to left, clean white gutters; crisp Chinese comic text in clean speech bubbles and narration boxes

items.label: object
items.caption: Top-right panel: inside a bright home kitchen at night snack time, the younger sister: a petite 14-year-old girl with bouncy pink twin tails, big round amber eyes, rosy cheeks, an oversized bright yellow hoodie with the hood down crouches in front of the open refrigerator, happily eating a caramel pudding cup with a small spoon, the fridge light glowing on her face.

items.label: object
items.caption: Top-left panel: the older sister: a tall 20-year-old young woman with straight glossy black shoulder-length bob hair, thin silver-framed glasses, calm sharp dark eyes, a crisp white blouse under a soft grey knit vest stands frozen in the kitchen doorway, one hand still on the door frame, her glasses glinting, staring at the empty pudding shelf in disbelief.

items.label: character
items.caption: Main center character focus breaking across the middle panels: 14-year-old, a petite girl with bouncy pink twin tails, big round amber eyes, rosy cheeks, an oversized bright yellow hoodie with the hood down, turns around in total panic, caramel pudding at the corner of her lips, eyes wide with sweat drops, both hands raised defensively while hiding the empty pudding cup behind her back.

items.label: object
items.caption: Middle-right small vertical panel: low-angle close-up of the older sister: a tall 20-year-old young woman with straight glossy black shoulder-length bob hair, thin silver-framed glasses, calm sharp dark eyes, a crisp white blouse under a soft grey knit vest pushing up her glasses with one finger, a cold, thin smile, a dark aura behind her as she slowly steps forward.

items.label: object

items.caption: Bottom wide panel: comedic chase, the younger sister: a petite 14-year-old girl with bouncy pink twin tails, big round amber eyes, rosy cheeks, an oversized bright yellow hoodie with the hood down bursts out of the frame to the left with her pink twin tails and hoodie strings flying straight up in fright, speed lines behind her; the older sister: a tall 20-year-old young woman with straight glossy black shoulder-length bob hair, thin silver-framed glasses, calm sharp dark eyes, a crisp white blouse under a soft grey knit vest chases from the right, glasses flashing white.
